notes: Stable patch for desktop connection access. Package defaults follow administrator-selected permissions; explicit read-only overrides are preserved. Claude MCPB bundles expose a configurable Read-only access setting and bridge site_info identifies device restrictions. Existing credentials, scopes, approvals and temporary maintenance gates remain unchanged. Existing desktop bundles need a one-time replacement/restart after the WordPress update. Native Claude execution is not newly certified; see the documented support scope.
